issues.issue: approval_program.summary states approval is based on TWO Phase 2 trials (CC-4047-MM-002 and IFM-2009-02), but pivotal_trials lists only one trial (CC-4047-MM-002); the second pivotal trial is missing.
Summary references IFM-2009-02 and its 34% ORR, but no corresponding pivotal_trials entry exists, creating a trial-count inconsistency with the structured data.

Text labels neutropenia (47%/38%), anemia (22%/21%), and pneumonia (16%/23%) as 'Grade 3/4' events, but the cited quotes (e.g., 'Neutropenia 50 (47) 43 (38)') contain no Grade 3/4 designation, so the grading characterization is unsupported by citation.

Automated uncited_numbers flags for '3' and '4' are the 'Grade 3/4' descriptors; they are a true problem (the quotes do not state Grade 3/4), subsumed by the higher-severity support issue above rather than a false positive.
